title: Observation record
description: Therapy status, measurements and patient-reported symptoms of one patient in one week of follow-up, in one scenario. One record per scenario, patient and week, from therapy start until a few weeks after the end of therapy or until death.

scenario_id.title: Scenario
scenario_id.description: Identifier of the intervention scenario, as in the scenario table.

week.title: Week
week.description: Week of follow-up. Week 0 starts with therapy start.

day.title: Day
day.description: First day of the week, counted from therapy start (day 1).

treatment_status.title: Therapy status
treatment_status.description: Status of the therapy in this week.

dose_level.title: Dose level
dose_level.description: Current dose as a fraction of the standard dose. Null after the therapy has stopped.

neutrophils_10e9_l.title: Neutrophils
neutrophils_10e9_l.description: Neutrophil count. Null if no blood test was done in this week.

haemoglobin_g_dl.title: Haemoglobin
haemoglobin_g_dl.description: Haemoglobin. Null if no blood test was done in this week.

platelets_10e9_l.title: Platelets
platelets_10e9_l.description: Platelet count. Null if no blood test was done in this week.

spo2_percent.title: Oxygen saturation
spo2_percent.description: Oxygen saturation at rest, measured at home. Null if not measured.

pro_fatigue.title: Fatigue
pro_fatigue.description: Patient-reported fatigue in the last week, from 0 (none) to 4 (very severe). Null if not reported.

pro_diarrhoea.title: Diarrhoea
pro_diarrhoea.description: Patient-reported diarrhoea in the last week, from 0 (none) to 4 (very severe). Null if not reported.

pro_cough.title: Cough
pro_cough.description: Patient-reported cough in the last week, from 0 (none) to 4 (very severe). Null if not reported.

pro_dyspnoea.title: Shortness of breath
pro_dyspnoea.description: Patient-reported shortness of breath in the last week, from 0 (none) to 4 (very severe). Null if not reported.
